senses.gloss: देश- + अतिथि देश- + अतिथि, m. a foreigner.
देश-काल- + क्षम देश-काल- + क्षम, adj. in accordance with place and time, Rām. 5, 49, 1.

देश देश, i. e. दिश् + अ, m.
 1. A place, Man. 2, 222.
 2. A part, a side, Kathās. 18, 280.
 3. A country, Rām. 1, 61, 10.
 4. When latter part of comp. words, often without a special signification, e. g. कण्ठ-देश = कण्ठ, Kathās. 17, 81; नितम्ब-, Ṛt. 1, 6; Rām. 1, 55, 3.
 --Comp.
देशक देशक, i. e. दिश् + अक, adj. Showing, teaching, Mārk. P. 19, 17.
देशज देश-ज, and देशजात देश-जात (vb. जन्), adj. Of genuine descent, born in the country whence comes the best kind (e. g. of horses, or elephants), Hariv. 6927; Rām. 1, 54, 21 Gorr.
देशना देशना, दिश्, Caus., + अन, f. Instruction, doctrine, Śatr. 14, 74.
देशान्तरिन् देशान्तरिन्, i. e. देश-अन्तर + इन्, adj. subst. m. Foreign, a foreigner, Śatr. 10, 135.

देशिक देशिक, i. e. देश + इक, m.
 1. A guide, MBh. 7, 143.
 2. A teacher, 13, 6847.
देशिनी देशिनी, i. e. दिश् + इन् + ई, f. The index or forefinger, Yājñ. 1, 19.

देशीय देशीय, i. e. देश + ईय, adj.
 1. Belonging to a country or province.
 2. Latter part of comp. adj. Bordering, being about, e. g. पञ्च(न्)-वर्ष + क-, About five years old, MBh. 12, 1119.

देश्य देश्य, i. e. देश + य,
 1. adj. subst. A witness, Man. 8, 52.
 2. adj. Belonging to a country, Rājat. 3, 9.
 3. adj. Of genuine descent, Rām. 2, 72, 23 Gorr. (cf. देशज).
 4. adj. Being almost, e. g. शिशु-, Being almost still a child, Rājat. 5, 220.
 --Comp.
देष्टृ देष्टृ, i. e. दिश् + तृ, m. One who shows, Bhāg. P. 6, 7, 14.
देश-भाषा देश-भाषा, f. the language of a country, MBh. 9, 2605.
देश- + रूप देश- + रूप, n. suitableness, MBh. 12, 3961.
देश-काल- + विरोधिन् देश-काल- + विरोधिन्, adj. acting contrary to place and time, Pañc. iii. d. 209.
